list.title: Revenue Recognition
list.description: Contracts, performance obligations, and recognition schedules (ASC 606).
list.emptyDescription: Post an invoice with a recognition-rule item to create obligations and schedules.

run.posted: Recognized {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} totaling {amount}

cancel.drawerHint: Ending this contract early? Cancel its recognition instead of voiding the invoice.
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: Describe why the remaining obligation is being cancelled
cancel.confirmBody: Posted recognition entries will be reversed, the remaining plan retired, and invoice {invoice} voided. This cannot be undone.

review.title: Run recognition
review.description: Review the exact entries before anything posts.
review.asOfHint: Lines due on or before this date. Defaults to today.
review.willPost: {count, plural, one {# line posts} other {# lines post}}
review.willSkip: {count, plural, one {# line held back} other {# lines held back}}
review.scopeChanged: The scope changed since this preview. Refresh before confirming.
review.nothingDue: Nothing due to recognize as of {date}
review.stale: The reviewed set changed. Preview again, then confirm.
review.errScope: That scope is no longer available. Reopen the drawer.
